evidence: Mining label; introduces `TxCollection` for validating externally constructed block templates against the mempool and chain tip via `TestBlockValidity`, refactors coinbase generation in `miner.cpp`, and adds block template interfaces.
rationale: Enables external mining coordinators to validate miner-selected block templates efficiently without maintaining a duplicate mempool mirror. Crucial for decentralized mining protocols like Stratum v2 JDS (sv2-apps #599) and weak block validation, significantly reducing resource use and template verification latency.
